producer_report.summary: The default-branch step of reused_baseline no longer asks main's CI about the base's own content commit. It reads main's tip from the local origin/<branch> ref. If the tip's governed-content fingerprint equals the base's, it takes that tip's green run through the existing green_run. If not, or if the tip is unknown, it adds a reason and the baseline runs locally. The root cause was that main holds a different squash commit with the same content, so the host never had the base's own commit. I added two tests, adjusted the existing default-branch test to create origin/main, rewrote the doc comment, and added a CHANGELOG entry under Fixed. `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_` passes (12 tests) and the policy scan passes.

checks_run.note: 12 passed, including both new tests and the three existing baseline tests

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs has main's tip as a squash commit that is not the base's content commit but has the same governed-content fingerprint, with a green CI run on main for that tip. It asserts the baseline has reused_from set to the run address, all checks are reused and passed, baseline_ran is false, and the host read was for the squash SHA on branch main. Run `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_reused`.
criteria_check.evidence: Added baseline_reused_from_a_squash_on_main_with_the_bases_fingerprint. It asserts reused_from, reused and passed on every check, baseline_ran false, and the read for head_sha=<tip> on branch=main. It passes under `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_`.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test has main's tip with a different governed-content fingerprint, even if it has a green run. It asserts the baseline runs locally (baseline_ran true, reused_from None) and the output line gives the fingerprint-mismatch reason. Run `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_runs_locally`.
criteria_check.evidence: Added baseline_runs_locally_when_main_tip_has_other_governed_content, with a green run for the differing tip. It asserts baseline_ran, reused_from None, no read of the tip, and the line 'baseline runs locally: ... has other governed content than the base'. It passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The existing baseline tests still pass unchanged in meaning: baseline_reused_from_the_landed_candidates_run_runs_nothing_locally, baseline_reused_from_the_default_branch_run_runs_nothing_locally, baseline_runs_locally_when_no_green_ci_result_exists, and the ci_reuse_* tests. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: The three named baseline tests pass. The default-branch test only gained an update-ref so origin/main exists. I did not run the ci_reuse_* tests or the whole athena-core suite; they do not touch the changed step beyond the default-branch lookup.

criteria_check.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs, the default-branch step of reused_baseline no longer passes the base's own content commit to green_run on the default branch. It passes main's commit chosen by matching fingerprint with the base's, and the doc comment of reused_baseline describes this.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the edited step: green_run is now given the tip from rev_parse(refs/remotes/origin/<branch>), only when its fingerprint equals the base's. Doc item 2 was rewritten to say so.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean, and the change touches only the reuse path, so the landed-candidate path and the local fallback are unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for clippy and fmt. I ran cargo fmt --all. Only the default-branch arm of reused_baseline changed.

open_issues: Only main's tip is checked; I did not add the bounded walk over first-parent ancestors that the reading suggested. A tip with other content, or a tip whose run is not green yet, falls back to a local baseline even if an older main commit has the base's content. The walk could be added if wanted.
I did not run the clippy check or the whole athena-core suite.
learnings: local_default_branch returns the bare branch name; the tip is read from refs/remotes/origin/<name> with Git::rev_parse.
The test seam EarlyFake/CiReplies::only_for filters reads by sha and branch, so a wrong sha shows up as no run.
